title: pogonospermum incanum
intro: Pogonospermum incanum, commonly known as Hooker's spurge or White Spurge, is a plant species within the Spurge family (Euphorbiaceae). It has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Pogonospermum incanum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids. However, more research is needed to confirm its full range of bioactive constituents and therapeutic actions.
